capability: Align the stable release-manifest contract with an explicitly owner-approved unsigned 1.0.2 release
searchEvidence: The protected package workflow and docs/ci/release-package.md already permit an unsigned stable package while retaining closed manifest, SHA-256, SBOM, provenance, smoke, legal, and release-owner gates.
The release-manifest JSON Schema already makes signingIdentity optional, so no schema or executable behavior change is required.

The existing release-manifest prose incorrectly says generation follows publishing/signing and limits omitted signing fields to beta/smoke packages; CHANGELOG separately lists signing as unfinished for 1.0.2.
semanticOwner: Release manifest contract and release-owner unsigned-package disposition
terminalContract: A stable package may omit signing fields only when the release owner explicitly approves that exact package for unsigned distribution; the approval changes no package bytes or executable admission rules and waives none of the closed-inventory, SHA-256, manifest, SBOM, provenance, archive-safety, package-smoke, legal/redistribution, protected-publication, or immutable-tag gates

designReview.evidence: Independent bounded R3 review approved the one governed manifest-contract path after requiring both contradictory statements to be corrected, positive owner-approved unsigned wording in CHANGELOG, retention of every integrity/publication gate, and exact-package release-owner evidence. No schema, workflow, packaging code, signing system, key custody, firmware, or runtime change is admitted.
